## 3. Notable Projects

### 1. RIAAQE (Realtime Interview Analysis & Adaptive Questioning Engine)
- **Role**: Lead Developer / Researcher
- **Type**: B.Tech Main Capstone Project (2024–2025)
- **Tech Stack**: Python, AI/ML, React.js, Node.js, Real-time Audio/Video Processing
- **Summary**: An AI-driven interview evaluation system that performs real-time audio and facial cue confidence analysis and dynamically suggests adaptive follow-up questions to interviewers based on candidate responses.

### 2. EXamin — Computer-Based Testing (CBT) Platform
- **Role**: Full-Stack Developer
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB
- **Summary**: A scalable online examination portal featuring section-based MCQ divisions, interactive question palettes, real-time timer tracking, and automated candidate evaluations.

### 3. EduCCET — Student Academic Mobile App
- **Role**: Mobile Developer
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter, Dart, Android
- **Summary**: A student companion mobile application designed for CCET engineering students to navigate course syllabi, compute credits, and plan their academic roadmap.

### 4. Digital Library System
- **Role**: Full-Stack Developer
- **Type**: B.Tech Mini Project
- **Tech Stack**: Web Technologies, Relational Database
- **Summary**: A centralized digital catalog for university students providing rapid search, book lending workflows, and access to past university question papers (PYQs).
